html:
The Vrancea earthquake struck Romania on the evening of 4 March 1977, centred deep under the Vrancea Mountains at the bend of the Carpathians, with a magnitude of about 7.4.

It killed about 1,500 people, around 1,400 of them in Bucharest, where dozens of tall prewar apartment blocks collapsed. It was also felt and caused damage in Bulgaria and Moldova. Ceaușescu cut short a trip to Africa and ordered the rubble cleared quickly. Many say he used the damage as a reason to tear down old quarters for his own building projects. The Vrancea zone produces strong deep quakes several times a century, and Bucharest still has many buildings at risk. It is the worst earthquake in modern Romania.
sum: The Vrancea earthquake struck Romania on the evening of 4 March 1977, centred deep under the Vrancea Mountains at the bend of the Carpathians, with a magnitude of about 7.4.
